acceptedAnswer.text: You create fully custom roles and manage permissions top-down for the whole organization, not project by project. The interface then automatically hides any feature or data a user lacks permission to see, keeping every screen clean.

mainEntity.name: Can it generate documents into our own templates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The one-click document generator pulls captured node data straight into your company's paperwork templates for immediate printing, reusable across one project or the entire organization.

mainEntity.name: How are notifications kept from becoming noise?

acceptedAnswer.text: An in-app dashboard filters critical warnings — such as qualification expirations and maintenance events — strictly by role, so leaders are informed without every phone on the floor being spammed.

Welding QMS software runs the quality-management side of a fabrication shop — who is authorised to do what, which documents are produced, and how records are controlled and versioned. Elenchon does this on-premise, keeping the whole quality system on hardware you own.

mainEntity.name: Is our quality data stored on-premise or in the cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: On-premise. Elenchon is a containerized appliance installed in your facility, so roles, templates and records never touch a shared cloud server. Authorised staff and auditors can still connect remotely through Phrakton, a zero-trust, post-quantum-safe overlay.
